label: Uneasy calm
summary: Markets cheered the Democratic midterm sweep: Wall Street's rally carried into Hong Kong and Sydney, and Brent slid to near $94, a two-month low, though an AI sell-off hit Seoul and Tokyo. Election deniers lost five swing-state governor races. The wars did not pause. Iran said two tankers and a tugboat burned in Hormuz, and the toll from Russia's strike on a Ukrainian aid site reached 40, with 59 missing, ahead of Abu Dhabi talks next week. North Korea tested new missiles, and Joshua Wong got 10 years in Hong Kong. Hundreds of Bangladeshi garment factories shut amid pay clashes. Ebola has killed over 5,300 people, but WHO experts backed two new vaccine trials. Whales died in a New Zealand stranding, while Brazil enlarged a Pantanal park. Israel's president accepted certified election results. The weighted formula gave 46; no editorial adjustment.
